# ex: needParen with unary expression in selector context
ex {
	var x *int
	F(x) -> G(*x)
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x *int) int { return *x }
func G(x int) int  { return x }

func H(p *int) int { return F(p) }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@
 func F(x *int) int { return *x }
 func G(x int) int  { return x }

-func H(p *int) int { return F(p) }
+func H(p *int) int { return G(*p) }
